items.title: FDA approves first gene therapy for Sanfilippo syndrome type A
items.summary: With a $3.95m price tag, Fayuvi – a one-time gene therapy – is one of the most expensive drugs on the market.

items.title: Novo targets oral macrocycles with $1.4bn Orbis partnership
items.summary: The deal reflects a growing interest from big pharma in the compounds that bridge the gap between small molecules and biologics.

items.title: Ona Therapeutics to develop ADC with WuXi’s payload-linker platform
items.summary: WuXi XDC Cayman is to provide Ona Therapeutics with an exclusive global licence to its WuXiTecan-2 platform to develop an ADC candidate.

items.title: Roche agrees to $1bn deal with Dualitas for bispecific antibody research
items.summary: Roche and Dualitas Therapeutics have entered a research and licence agreement to develop bispecific antibodies for I&I diseases.

items.title: The shrinking return on investment for Nordic innovation
items.summary: Nordic biopharma innovation outpaces commercialization as regional biotechs struggle to raise the capital needed to upscale.
